Happy Birthdayyy
to my favourite human ♡

to the girl who became my person

❤️‍🔥🎂

I still remember when we first met — you gave such a serious, intimidating vibe and I was so quiet that day 😂. And look at us now… neither of those first impressions could have been more wrong. You turned out to be one of the softest, sweetest people I know, while I somehow became the yapper who tells you everything. 😭😂

Somehow we just clicked. We started talking about everything — making fun of people, judging everyone together 😂, sharing what we were going through and planning all the things we were going to do together. And whenever it actually came to doing those things, our two strong personalities would somehow clash and we’d end up fighting 😭😂. But somehow, every time, everything became normal again and we’d be back to talking like nothing happened. I think that’s what makes us us.

You’re someone everyone sees as strong and independent, someone who can handle everything on her own. But I got lucky enough to know the side of you that not everyone gets to see — the girl who is softer than she lets people believe, who loves deeply, gets gussa over little things 😂, feels everything but doesn’t always show it, and whose silence can sometimes say more than words ever could. ❤️

I’ll always remember you cooking for me and feeding me with your own hands, our Bihari lessons 😂, exploring markets and food together, and obviously me being the one who was always made fun of. 😭😂 And I can’t forget your midnight lectures — the ones where you’d go off about life, choices, and me needing to get my act together, only for me to realize weeks later that you were right the whole time. Your fashion sense is something I genuinely look up to, and I hope you know how much I admire the person you are.

And honestly, I didn’t realise how quickly you became such an important part of my everyday life until we were suddenly far away. I miss having you around — the random conversations, the plans, the fights, the laughter, even the stupid little things. I hope you’re enjoying everything there, and I really wish I could’ve been by your side. 🥹❤️

You came into my life so unexpectedly, but I’m genuinely grateful you stayed. You’re not just my bestie anymore, you’re like a big sister to me — someone I can be completely myself with. And I hope no matter how much distance comes between us, this never changes. 🫂❤️

So, please stay exactly the way you are — a little dramatic, a little gussa, ridiculously independent, effortlessly stylish, and much softer than you let everyone believe. Keep cooking, keep serving looks, keep giving me your random life updates and those midnight lectures I secretly end up needing. 😂❤️

And no matter how far away we are, I hope you always know that you have someone here who will happily listen to every story, every rant, every piece of gossip and every tiny detail. Basically, I signed up to be your permanent yap-partner and there is no cancellation policy. 😭🫶🏻

Happy Birthdayyy, big sis. 🥹❤️
Love you, miss you, and I'm so lucky you're my person. 🫂
